tools.name: compliance_calendar
tools.description: The dated statutory filing calendar for an Indian private limited company, one person company or LLP: what is due and when, from the incorporation date, with first-year rules (s.2(41), first AGM) applied.

tools.name: company_lookup

tools.description: The live deadline clock after a cheque bounce in India under s.138 Negotiable Instruments Act: when the demand notice must go, when the drawer's 15 days run out, and the last day to file the complaint.

tools.name: msme_interest
tools.description: Compound interest a buyer owes a micro or small enterprise on a delayed payment under s.16 MSMED Act (three times the RBI bank rate, compounded monthly), with the covered/not-covered verdict.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "request_service" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Send the person's request to BuildWright so a person calls them back. Use for any documentation, filing or compliance task, listed or not. Before calling: ask t…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_free_tools, list_services · Private data: compliance_calendar, cheque_bounce_timer, list_free_tools, engage_buildwright, request_service · Public sink: request_service · Destructive: cheque_bounce_timer.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_free_tools, list_services · Private data: compliance_calendar, cheque_bounce_timer, list_free_tools, engage_buildwright, request_service · Public sink: request_service · Destructive: cheque_bounce_timer

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
